newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine to sell 15 pct of steel maker.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine to sell 15 pct of steel maker.

text.p: Ukraine's State Property Fund (FDM) plans to sell 15 percent of the Zaporizhstal steel factory to a strategic foreign investor, it said on Monday.
A deadline for investment tender has not been established and will have to be approved by the government, it said in a statement.

Zaporizhstal, located in the eastern industrial city of Zaporizhya, is one of 208 companies designated by the government to be sold to a strategic investor who would modernise the company and make it profitable.
Zaporizhstal's authorised capital is 281.2 million hryvnia ($156.2 million).

Employees are entitled to 11.9 percent of shares, 10 percent will be sold for privatisation certificates, 25.1 percent will remain in government hands, and 38 percent will be made available for direct investment.

Interfax Ukraine news agency reported that for the first nine months of this year Zaporizhstal produced 1.5 million tonnes of pig-iron, 1.7 million tonnes of steel, about 1.4 million tonnes of rolled steel, and 28.2 million tonnes of tin. --Natalya Zinets, Kiev Newsroom +380 44 229 2264
